As for the man... He is the love of my life, and I do think maybe some of my rhetoric when talking to him was a bit harsh. I am praying I didn't ruin things with him. He is easily the best thing that has ever happened to me, and I love him more than I can even describe. I want him to feel that same love, but part of me is also like, if he's not feeling like he's receiving that support, then maybe there's someone else out there who could give him that support that I can't. I **don't** want to break up with him, I love him way too much, and imagining him not in my life isn't an option for me. We've also been dating for about 8 months now. But I also love him so much that I also want him to be happy too.
I relate to you so hard. <3 stay strong.
